sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.atom_id) + COUNT(DISTINCT c.atom_id2) AS atom_count
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-' AND (a1.element = 'i' AND a2.element = 's' OR a1.element = 's' AND a2.element = 'i')
GROUP BY b.bond_id
